title: Surge win below threshold never emits a terminal event — run-level soft-lock (GDD lose row unimplemented)
detail: Surge ending with uptime < threshold emits nothing: no win branch, no lose branch (app session: WIN_GOAL 0, LOSE_TICK_CAP 0). Losses spread within per-class tolerances mean no breach, so the meter recharges to 100 and the run never terminates.
recommended_fix: On surge_done with total > 0 and uptime < threshold, emit Run_Lost (the GDD lose row: below threshold during surge → fail). Keep zero-completion windows neutral per E24.

title: balance.json health.win_uptime_pct is dead data — win threshold has a second, hardcoded source of truth
detail: Loaded, validated (1..100), and folded into catalog_hash, but never read by sim, app, or harness — the win check uses run-setup surge_win_pct. Tuning the balance knob re-blesses every golden with zero behavior change; ODN-5 single-source claim in the Balance comment is violated.
recommended_fix: Either default surge_win_pct from cat.balance.health.win_uptime_pct when the run flag is unset, or delete the field from Balance/validation/data and rely on the run-setup flag alone.

title: Rolling-window sum update depends on silent u64 wrap-around for an intermediate underflow
evidence:
h.win_delivered[c] += dd - u64(h.ring[slot].delivered)
		h.win_dropped[c] += dp - u64(h.ring[slot].dropped)
		h.win_latency[c] += dl - h.ring[slot].latency_ms
detail: When a class's per-tick delta is smaller than the windowed-out slot's (a burst settles), the intermediate subtraction underflows u64; correctness holds only via two's-complement wrap-around. Any future overflow-checked build flag makes this a runtime panic.
recommended_fix: Reorder to add before subtracting: h.win_latency[c] = h.win_latency[c] + dl - h.ring[slot].latency_ms (same for delivered/dropped), so no intermediate goes negative.

title: Grace expiry is silently eventless when every drained class has severity 0, which validation permits
detail: Grace_Expired is emitted only inside the drain > 0 branch; a class whose grace expires while all post-grace classes have severity 0 (valid per the >= 0 check) emits nothing and never drains — the expiry contract breaks for a validated input.
recommended_fix: Validate health_drain_pct_per_tick >= 1, or emit the Grace_Expired events for the expired list independently of whether drain is positive.
